name: Clarification pending → executing→awaiting_approval
description:
ADR-053 Phase 4b-2 PR-1 — the interactive-pause transition, half 2 (the run-entity transition). Fires on the RUN entity (agent.chain.execution.<runID>) when rule 07 or 08 has stamped agent.run.clarification_pending there AND the run is still `executing`. Advances the run to `awaiting_approval` via lifecycle_transition (the firing entity = the run entity, which is what the action transitions). The run is now honestly paused on a human reply rather than misleadingly `executing`.

Mirrors 02-dispatched-to-executing.json exactly (marker trigger + top-level phase guard + lifecycle_transition). The executing→awaiting_approval edge is already legal in the upstream transition table (agentrun.go), so no lifecycle change.

PHASE GUARD IS A TOP-LEVEL CONDITION, NOT AN ACTION `when` (Coby review round 2): agent.run.phase==executing is a rule condition, so the rule is simply not-matching until the edge is legal — the illegal transition is never attempted and the durable clarification_pending marker re-drives the transition exactly once when the phase is executing (beta.103+ re-evaluates every entity-state rule per KV revision).

SHARED PHASE WITH 4c: awaiting_approval is also 4c's tool-gate phase. They are distinguished by CAUSE, not phase: 4b-2 stamps agent.run.clarification_pending + the asking loop has coordinator.user_question and NO pending_approval; 4c's tool-gate sets pending_approval. The UI follow-up disambiguates on those triples.

DOES NOT collide with 03/04 (executing→completed/failed): a recovery coordinator's ask_user stamps clarification_pending but NOT agent.run.outcome, so rules 03/04 do not fire; and once the run is awaiting_approval their phase==executing guard excludes them. PR-1 ends here (run parked in awaiting_approval); PR-2 adds the resume + marker-clear.

on_enter.reason: coordinator asked the user a clarifying question — run paused awaiting reply (ADR-053 4b-2)

metadata.fires_on: the run entity (agent.chain.execution.<runID>) — same firing-entity discipline as 02/03/04.
metadata.phase_guard_is_condition: agent.run.phase==executing is a TOP-LEVEL CONDITION (not an action `when`) so the invalid edge is never attempted (Coby review round 2).
metadata.edge_is_legal_upstream: executing→awaiting_approval is already in the agentrun lifecycle transition table — no upstream change.
metadata.vs_4c: Shares awaiting_approval with 4c's approval_required tool-gate; distinguished by cause (clarification_pending + coordinator.user_question vs pending_approval), not by phase.
metadata.pr1_end_state: PR-1 has no resume — the run parks in awaiting_approval (strictly more honest than the prior executing-forever-on-ask_user). PR-2 adds awaiting_approval→executing + clears clarification_pending.
